On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. blocks.text: Condo buildings in Scottsdale
Delta Rise — 11967 80 Avenue

Built 2017; listings describe it as Delta's / North Delta's only high-rise condo, a concrete high-rise of 38 storeys (listing data) with over 20,000 sq ft of amenities including a gym, garden, recreation room and playground, plus exercise centre, in-suite laundry, storage locker and concierge in listing amenity fields. A current listing records pets as "Yes" for units at this address. Unit count: Not confirmed from the sources checked (a unit count appears only in a source this series does not cite). Restrictions beyond the listing-level pet note: Not confirmed.
Chancellor Place — 11910 80 Avenue and 11920 80 Avenue (two towers)

Listings describe a concrete high-rise complex with secure underground parking, an indoor heated pool, exercise room and activity/meeting room. Year-built conflict: listings for 11910 80 Avenue give both 1989 and 1990, and listings for 11920 80 Avenue give 1990 — treat the complex's build year as 1989/1990, sources differ. Unit counts: Not confirmed from the sources checked. Restrictions trap: an older listing for a 11910 unit states "No Rentals, No Pets & 19+ Age Restriction" — that is one dated listing's text, not current law: the rental line has been void since November 24, 2022, and a 19+ threshold is not a permitted age bylaw (only 55+ is —). Confirm the registered bylaws on the Form B.
Atria (Atria Residences) — 7511 120 Street

Built 2012; listings describe a 4-storey, wood-frame building with brick/mixed exterior, a mixed-use ground floor (a current commercial listing for a ground-floor strata unit describes a well-maintained 2012-built mixed-use building; the strata plan for that unit is EPS930), with a gym, party lounge, meeting room, playground and two elevators in listing descriptions. Unit count: Not confirmed from the sources checked. Restrictions: Not confirmed from public sources.
Trend — 7445 120 Street

Built 2010, 51 units (building directory, secondary source). Directory amenities: bike room, elevator, in-suite laundry, storage, wheelchair access. The directory page checked states no restriction set for this building, so pet/rental/age restrictions are not confirmed — read them off the Form B.
Streets, schools and getting around Scottsdale

items.t: Scottsdale is the south-east corner of North Delta in the City of Delta, along Scott Road (120 Street) at the Surrey border; the City does not publish a street-by-street written boundary, and the working grid used is 72 Avenue south, 84 Avenue north, 112 Street west, Scott Road east — a working grid, not an official boundary. Note: the Scottsdale Exchange itself sits on the Surrey side of Scott Road, per the City.

Where the condo stock concentrates: (1) the 80 Avenue / Scott Road tower node — Delta Rise (11967 80 Avenue) and the two Chancellor Place towers (11910 and 11920 80 Avenue); (2) the Scott Road low-rise strip south of there — Atria (7511 120 Street) and Trend (7445 120 Street).

Transit is the area's defining feature: Scottsdale Exchange is the bus hub, with routes including the 310, 312, 316, 319, 322, 329, 340, 364 and 391, and the R6 Scott Road RapidBus between Scott Road Station and Newton Exchange.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Scottsdale

items.t: City zoning, TOD and plans: zoning is parcel-by-parcel under Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, under the Delta Official Community Plan 2024, consolidated Bylaw No. 8400 (no lettered area-plan schedules; the North Delta Area Plan was Schedule C.1 under the repealed Bylaw No. 3950). The 2024 OCP designates a Scottsdale Exchange TOD Area, and the City states Bill 47 requires minimum densities within a Transit Oriented Development Area extending 400 metres from Scottsdale Exchange — the policy frame behind the 80 Avenue towers.

blocks.text: Good to know about Scottsdale

items.t: North Delta's entire tower stock stands within about two blocks: Delta Rise (2017) and both Chancellor Place towers (1989/1990) are all on 80 Avenue at Scott Road — outside that node, Scottsdale's condo stock is four-storey wood-frame (Atria, 2012; Trend, 2010). (Sources: entries above.)

The "Scottsdale" mall and exchange are not quite in Scottsdale: the City states Scottsdale Exchange sits on the Surrey side of Scott Road, and the Village at Sunshine Hills presale material likewise places Scottsdale Centre mall across 70 Avenue from that project, on the Scott Road corridor — cross-border geography is normal at this corner and affects exact walk-time claims.

Chancellor Place's two towers carry two postal codes and two build years in listings: 11910 is V4C 8E3 and 11920 is V4C 8E8 in listing data, with 1989 and 1990 both appearing for the complex — a small thing that breaks automated searches if only one address/year is used.

Delta Rise's amenity claim is unusually large for Delta: listings put its amenity space at over 20,000 sq ft (gym, garden, recreation room, playground) — when comparing its strata fee to Trend's or Atria's, part of the fee is buying that amenity plant, not just insurance and maintenance.

items.t: Nearby areas: Sunshine Hills Woods to the west (south of 72 Avenue on the Nicholson Road side — the boundary that decides the two excluded complexes), Nordel to the north-west, and Newton (Surrey) across Scott Road to the east.
Schools: SD37 catchments are address-based, with no middle tier.

Parent community (North Delta) combined median: $622,500, $479/sq ft, 98% sale-to-list, 48 days on market — a combined condo+towhome community figure, never a Scottsdale townhome median; sub-area medians are not published.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Scottsdale

items.t: Strata townhomes — Form B diligence: Strata Property Act s.59 — the Form B states monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.

SSMUH and transit-oriented density: Delta's SSMUH bylaws are Bylaws No. 8394 and 8395, adopted June 24, 2024 — four units on all residential properties in Delta, and Delta's SSMUH regulations allow combinations of single detached dwellings, duplex dwellings, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites with reduced parking. Separately, the City states Bill 47 requires minimum densities within a Transit Oriented Development Area extending 400 metres from Scottsdale Exchange — two similar lots can sit under different density expectations on either side of that line.

Flood / ALR: no floodplain statement specific to Scottsdale was confirmed in the sources read, and OCP Map 2 shows no Agricultural designation for this part of North Delta; parcel-level ALR status is a check through the Agricultural Land Commission. Where ALR land is involved anywhere in Delta, an ALR residence cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)).

Delta property taxes and utilities: 2026 property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty after July 2 and a further 5% after September 2, 2026; the approved 2026 Financial Plan included a 2.9% property tax increase for City operational services, and Delta's 2026 flat-rate utility fee is $1,658 for a single-family home.

blocks.text: Good to know about Scottsdale

items.t: Oakcrest is much newer than the sub-area's other verified townhouse stock: built 2022 against Briarwood Estates' 1988 — a 34-year age gap between the only two verified complexes, which is why depreciation-report and CRF diligence reads very differently on the two purchases even though both are strata. Basis: above.

Scottsdale Exchange is in Surrey: the transit hub the whole sub-area is named around sits on the Surrey side of Scott Road at 72 Avenue, per the City. Delta-side marketing that puts the exchange "in Scottsdale, Delta" does not match the City's statement.

The R6 is the corridor's dated upgrade: the R6 Scott Road RapidBus runs between Scott Road Station and Newton Exchange with a boarding area at Scott Road and 72nd Avenue — the transit fact that anchors the TOD designation around the exchange.

Chalmers Park is the in-grid recreation anchor: 11400 76A Ave, with pickleball, sport courts, sports fields, tennis courts, trails and washrooms per the City listing; no recreation centre inside the Scottsdale working grid was confirmed — the North Delta Recreation Centre at 11415 84 Avenue serves North Delta, and the George Mackie Library is at 8440 112th Street at the area's north-west edge in Nordel.

blocks.text: Scottsdale home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

16 condos sold in Scottsdale with a median price of $505,000 (the middle half sold between $442,500 and $580,750), taking a median of 55 days to sell at 95.8% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $639 per square foot, a median year built of 2017 and a median strata fee of $438 a month. 5 townhomes sold in Scottsdale with a median price of $800,000, taking a median of 15 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 20% sold above list. They had a median $607 per square foot, a median year built of 2022 and a median strata fee of $392 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Scottsdale?

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Scottsdale had a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is Scottsdale a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: 11 condos and townhomes sold in Scottsdale over those 5 months, out of 42 in all of North Delta.

faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?

faq.a: No. The rental ban has been void since November 24, 2022, and 19+ is not a permitted age threshold — only a 55+ bylaw is allowed under Strata Property Act ss. 123.1/123.2. A pet bylaw can still be enforceable. All three lines come from one older listing; the registered bylaws on the Form B are the only reliable statement.
faq.q: A listing says Chancellor Place is "No Rentals, No Pets, 19+." Can all three still apply?

faq.a: Age drives it: the depreciation report is mandatory every five years for both, but a 35-plus-year-old concrete tower's report prices elevator, parkade and envelope cycles that a 2017 tower has not reached. Compare the CRF balance and the report's funding models, not the headline strata fee.
faq.q: What is the levy risk in the 1989/1990 Chancellor Place towers versus the 2017 Delta Rise?

faq.a: Yes — it is a mixed-use strata (EPS930): a current commercial listing offers a ground-floor retail/office strata unit in the same 2012-built building as the residences above. Mixed-use stratas can have separate sections and cost-sharing formulas — check how costs split between the residential and commercial sections on the Form B.
faq.q: Is Atria really a condo building if it has shops/offices at grade?

faq.a: The strata plan number (NWS2710) and the 1988 build year were re-verified on a citable listing record; the count was not.
faq.q: A directory gives Briarwood 42 units. Can I quote that?

faq.a: No — citable listing records state Ownership Type: Freehold Strata for Oakcrest units, built 2022. New does not mean fee-simple; the Form B document set applies.

What did condos in Scottsdale sell for?

faq.a: The median was 55 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.8% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
